title: P0 bugs from pre-migration review passes
close_reason:
All three children closed. This was the last open P0 on the board.

PKIX-4ca.1 (P0, cache freshness using SystemTime::now() against the validator's now_unix) was closed earlier. PKIX-4ca.3 (the is_aia_recoverable / SignatureInvalid question) and PKIX-4ca.2 (the AIA_MAX_DEPTH off-by-one) are closed by commits 8f2feb8c and 4ad34968.

Both of the remaining two were re-filings of PKIX-q9hv children, and in both cases the re-filing was worth distrusting. .3 landed at P2 while its original sat at P0 and had dropped the entire analysis; the capability it proposed removing turned out to be nearly working and worth keeping, and was broken only for the likelier of two shapes. .2 was a verification task for a fix already landed — the fix was real, but nothing had demonstrated it in the five months since, and the documented semantics of the constant were still ambiguous about whether a cap of N resolved N hops or N-1.

Worth noting for whoever sweeps the rest: of the two issues in this epic that needed work, neither needed the work its own description proposed.
